mapper.select: SELECT f.*, o.name AS owner_name, CONCAT(h.building, '-', h.unit, '-', h.room_number) AS house_info FROM fee f LEFT JOIN owner o ON f.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN house h ON f.house_id = h.id WHERE f.id = #{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fee (owner_id, house_id, fee_type, amount, should_pay_date, paid_date, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{houseId}, #{feeType}, #{amount}, #{shouldPayDate}, #{paidDate}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
